title: Successful run predicate
statement: A Boolean list $D$ is deemed to have a successful run exactly when the result of applying $sW$ to $D$ is nonempty and satisfies the completion predicate.
caveat: The operations $sW$, $isNilB$, and $isDone$ are not defined in the payload, so their underlying mathematical meanings are unavailable.
